facts.fact: Chil Group, a private digital health company, says it supplies its own zero-cost EMR software holding patients' digital health records to its partner health facilities, 67% of which have inpatient capacity (more than 260 wards); the number and tier of facilities are not given.
facts.system: Chil Group Electronic Medical Record (EMR) software

systems.system: Chil Group Electronic Medical Record (EMR) software
systems.tiers: Chil Group partner health facilities, including rural facilities with inpatient wards; tiers not stated
